title: Montenegro 1943 - Mountain Stream - 10c Postage Stamp Italian Occupation Issue
descriptionText: The product is a 10c postage stamp from Montenegro, issued during the Italian occupation in 1943. This stamp features a mountain stream design and is categorized as mail aerea. It is a used stamp from the specified year of issue and is uncertified. This piece of history represents a unique moment in the history of Montenegro and Italian occupation during World War II.
